record.field: -- perspective: {"plugin": "Datagrid", "group_by": ["Salesperson"], "split_by": ["Year"], "columns": ["Revenue"], "sort": [["Revenue", "col desc"]]} -- the confirmed order lines, by salesperson and month : a pivot to move in the browser SELECT "salesman_id" AS "Salesperson", STRFTIME("order_id.date_order", '%Y') AS "Year", STRFTIME("order_id.date_order", '%Y-%m') AS "Month", COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS "Orders", SUM("product_uom_qty") AS "Units", SUM("price_subtotal") AS "Revenue" FROM d WHERE "state" NOT IN ('draft', 'sent', 'cancel') GROUP BY "Salesperson", "Year", "Month" ORDER BY "Month", "Salesperson"
